messages:
Alex R.: Heads-up — seeing a sustained p99 latency spike for text-gen in eu-west for ~20m. Alerts are flapping and will wake the overnight rotation. Primary tonight is @Sara Ops, secondary @Jon P. Can we decide a short-lived threshold/aggregation tweak to reduce noise?

Incident Bot: :rotating_light: Pager: GEN-TX-LATENCY-P99 eu-west — fired 3 times in last 10m (count=38). Pager policy: page on >=2 fires in 5m.

Sara Ops: I can take first look. If this is capacity-related we might have a coverage gap between 23:00-01:00 when Paul C. is on a delayed flight. Who can be backup if I need to hand off?

Jon P.: Paul said he can be reachable by phone after 23:30 but not reliable until 01:00. If this needs infra-level work we should escalate to eng-sre sooner.

Maria G.: Proposal: temporarily move GEN-TX-LATENCY-P99 alert from `p99 > 800ms over 5m` to `p99 > 1200ms over 10m` for the next 6 hours (eu-west only). Rationale: tokenization fanout + small batch jitter is causing spurious pages, customer impact so far is low (no 5xx increase). We'll record it as a planned SLO alert suppression window.

Alex R.: +1 to Maria's plan if we also set an automated rollback at 06:00 local. Need one person to apply the change and note it in the incident log.

Sara Ops: I can monitor and apply the rule if you post the exact Prometheus rule change or the API call. I'll also keep the on-call bridge open if pages continue.

Maria G.: Copy paste the change below — use with `ops-alerts` token.
```yaml
# temporary: bump p99 threshold eu-west
alert: GEN_TX_LATENCY_P99_EU_TEMP
expr: histogram_quantile(0.99, rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket{region=\"eu-west\",model=\"text-gen\"}[10m])) > 1.2
for: 10m
labels:
  severity: page
annotations:
  summary: \"GEN text-gen p99 > 1.2s (temp override)\"
```

Maria G.: If you can't push YAML, there's a quick mute endpoint: 
```bash
curl -X POST "https://alerts.example.internal/api/mute" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPS_ALERTS_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"alert":"GEN-TX-LATENCY-P99","duration":"6h","reason":"overnight temp suppression eu-west"}'
```

Jon P.: We should also create a linked note in the SLO dashboard so the SLO math excludes this window for alerting regressions later. Otherwise we'll get false positives in monthly reports.

Alex R.: Good point. Maria, can you add a short memo to the SLO dashboard and the incident tracker? Format: why, who applied, time range, rollback time.

Maria G.: Will do. I'll add the memo and push the rule now. I'll also set a rollback job at 06:00 UTC+0.

Incident Bot: :white_check_mark: Patch request accepted (PR #3428). Change will be applied in 30s.

Sara Ops: Applying the mute via curl now. Monitoring logs and tailing `prod-gen` routers.

Paul C.: I'm available as backup after 23:30 by phone. If it looks like autoscaling isn't catching up, tag me and I'll join.

Rotation Bot: Updated oncall: Sara Ops (primary) 22:00-06:00, Jon P. (secondary) 22:00-02:00, Paul C. (backup) 23:30-06:00.

Alex R.: Thanks. Two operational notes: 1) If error rate (5xx) spikes above 2% or token drop rate >5% for >10m, escalate to eng-sre immediately. 2) If the number of pages remains >5 in any 30m window, revert the suppress and investigate deeper.

Jon P.: I'll keep a watch on error metrics and will open an SRE bridge if either condition trips.

Maria G.: Memo posted: \"Temp p99 threshold bump eu-west — 1718200455 to 1718224855 UTC. Applied by Maria G. Reason: transient batch jitter causing noisy p95/p99 pages. Rollback scheduled 06:00 UTC. SLO dashboard flagged to ignore this window for alert regression checks.\" Link: <internal/incidents/1718200455>

Sara Ops: Seeing p99 come down slightly but still elevated. No increase in 5xx. Holding oncall bridge for 45m and will update every 15m.

Alex R.: Great. If things drift after rollback time, we'll run the full playbook in the runbook: `/runbooks/latency-gen-p99` (steps: confirm region, collect trace ids, increase capacity pool, restart model shard if necessary).

Sara Ops: Acknowledged — will ping if I need a hand. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
